entries.name: ARMATURE Fabric
entries.summary: ARMATURE Fabric is accreditation management software used by accrediting bodies and their stakeholders to run application-to-decision accreditation and re-accreditation cycles, with tailored portals, online self-studies/assessments/final reports, standards-referenced templates, reviewer teams, and cycle/activity tracking.

leaf_matches.reason: 官方产品页面向认证机构及其评审方，描述从申请到决定的认证/再认证周期管理、标准与模板、在线自评/评估/最终报告、评审组与决策环节；符合认证机构运营方的程序管理核心。
